objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid after release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies relevant to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas where the document applies.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle, released directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing document, created by users with author rights without affecting the document content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-created request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to re-validate a previously invalidated document, only creatable by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning authorizations such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, or archive access.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and participate in workflows.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the person (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons maintained per document who are automatically informed about document releases.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A task assigned to a participant within a workflow process requiring completion with electronic signature or confirmation.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow step (e.g. Creator, Review, Release, Acknowledgement).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to complete their tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or modified through the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step by confirming the technical or formal check with electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step with electronic signature to finally release the document.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection.

evts.name: reject_in_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_in_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new attachment (controlled document) is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is extended through the validity extension workflow, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group, and the archive duration starts.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request for reactivation of an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translation of a released document into another language is initiated.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow-supported approval process.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or other document events.
